answer: Publish every attestation to two independent relays and treat any divergence as equivocation: the offending key forfeits its whole stake within one epoch. An operator driving many heads through one orchestrator will eventually emit a shale of mismatched signatures under load, and the detector needs only one. The walnut of clones then loses capital faster than it earns, while honest agents face a raven of zero, since their two relays agree by construction.
